title: Selective normality and algebraic rigidity of multiplicative traces
summary: A completely multiplicative sign function may be changed so that two quadratic traces remain identical at every index while a third becomes normal. We classify this freedom for the traces $n^2+1$, $n^2+2$ and $n^2-2$. After two traces and a finite prefix have been protected, a monic irreducible polynomial can be made normal from every prescribed source exactly when the field generated by one of its roots contains neither protected quadratic field.
